rules: Use 'Grid Borders' micro-theme: Expose the skeleton with 1px solid borders.
95% monochrome. Color exists only to guide action (e.g., Active Mic = Signal Red, Success/Focus = Klein Blue).
Generous spacing inside grid items (`p-8` or `p-12`).

scale.large_input: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl leading-snug font-mono focus:outline-none

layout.structure: A massive screen-filling CSS Grid container (`h-screen`).
grid_setup: Header spans full width, bottom border.
Main area split 50/50: Left is Source, Right is Target (or Top/Bottom on mobile).
Divided by a 1px solid black border.
The swap button sits exactly on the intersection of the two panes.

components_strategy.inputs: Naked textareas (`bg-transparent border-none resize-none focus:ring-0`). Let the grid cell act as the bounding box.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges, flat colors. Hover state inverts background and text color (`hover:bg-black hover:text-white`).
components_strategy.toolbars: Located at the bottom of each pane, separated by a top border within the pane. Flex layout, items separated by right borders.

motion.hover: Instant color inversion or sharp translation (`-translate-y-1` with hard shadow). No soft easing.
motion.active: Mic recording pulses border or text color in Signal Red.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, sharp and functional.

features.real_time_translation: Translate dynamically as the user types (with debounce logic).
features.speech_to_text: Whisper-powered voice input. Show recording status clearly.
features.text_to_speech: Play audio of the translated text.
features.bidirectional: Swap button switches the source/target languages and swaps the current text.
features.copy: Copy to clipboard button with feedback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard .js files for React components, NOT .tsx.

Do not use generic Shadcn Card or Input wrappers if they introduce rounded corners or default ring shadows. Stick to the 'Swiss Brutalism' raw HTML/Tailwind approach: 'border border-black rounded-none'.
Implement the UI as a split-screen design on desktop (grid-cols-2) and stacked on mobile (grid-cols-1).
For the swap button, position it absolutely in the center of the grid on desktop, or simply between the two panes.
Ensure the translation is called via a mocked API or an actual GPT-5.2 service if provided in the backend. If mocked, highlight it clearly in the UI.
Ensure Whisper and TTS are integrated. If audio APIs aren't fully available, mock the endpoints but keep the UI fully functional with state changes (e.g., playing state, recording state).
